title: High-Performance Zero-Allocation Pub/Sub
body: ViceSharp shall implement the internal Pub/Sub interconnect with fixed-capacity message storage, 64-byte inline payloads, a MessageKind discriminant, preallocated subscriber route arrays, synchronous publish/delivery, no boxing, and zero managed heap allocation on the steady-state hot path.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Publishing one million typed messages to one subscriber is below 50ns per publish operation.
Publishing one million typed messages to three subscribers is below 100ns per publish/delivery operation.
Message pool rent/return is below 20ns and uses fixed-capacity slot handles.
PayloadArena allocation is below 10ns and supports frame reset semantics.
The typed publish hot path performs zero managed allocations after warmup.
Default message pool capacity is 8192 slots and does not resize during emulation.
Delivery order is deterministic in registration order and preserved when subscriber route arrays grow.
